title: Juicy American Bean Sprouts Casserole
description: A low-fat, wine-infused American dish featuring chewy bean sprouts, perfect for meal prep. This casserole emulsifies flavors for a rich taste experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the ground turkey to the skillet, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until it is no longer pink.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, allowing the flavors to meld.
Add the red wine, chicken broth, and bean sprouts to the skillet, bringing the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture cook, covered, for 10 minutes, allowing the flavors to emulsify.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with shredded low-fat cheddar cheese.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
